items.title: Transnet Rail Support Deal Might Change The Case For Investing In Wabtec Stock
items.summary: Wabtec Corporation priced a public offering of US$500 million in 5.9% senior notes due 2037, and separately finalized a roughly US$390 million long term Material and Technical Support Agreement with Transnet Engineering to support Class D43 and D44 locomotives in South Africa.
